detect_body_pose: detect body poses and bounding boxes from an input image using the BodyPoseEstimator model
create_body_pose_estimator: create a BodyPoseEstimator instance that loads the pretrained MobileNet pose estimation model
infer_fast_heatmaps: run fast inference on an image to extract heatmaps and PAFs for pose estimation
load_body_estimator_model: load the pretrained body pose estimator checkpoint into a PoseEstimationWithMobileNet model
extract_body_keypoints: extract and group body keypoints from heatmaps and PAFs to produce pose entries and bounding boxes
